title: Chapter 279: Cerberus Vs. Undead Burning Legion
content:
Chapter 279: Cerberus Vs. Undead Burning Legion

After Wang Shuo repelled this wave of undead attacks, he immediately contacted Ayub.

"Abu, what is the situation in Nanshanji now?"

After the first wave of undead attacks, Wang Shuo saw that the defense pressure was not great, so he asked Ayub to take 2,000 Red Flame Army to reinforce Nanshanji.

Earlier, the reserve troops of the Red Flame Army were stationed in Nanshanji, with a total of 5,000 people.

After a few days of training, the number of Red Flame Army has increased to 10,000.

Nanshanji has 1,500 city defense troops, plus 3,000 Red Flame Army, Wang Shuo is confident that he can defend this town.

"My Lord, our long-range firepower is limited, and we are still in a stalemate."

Wang Shuo expressed his understanding.

After all, Wang Shuo left the long-range troops of the Red Flame Army in Wana Town, which is Wang Shuo's base camp and must be preserved.

"Okay, hold on for a while, I'll send the long-range troops to support you."

After that, he asked Li Jianguo and Gong Kai to take their troops through the teleportation array and move to Nanshanji.

Wang Shuo himself took his three-headed hellhound troops out of the city.

The Burning Legion outside the city was already a remnant of defeated soldiers, and most of them had less than half of their health.

Wang Shuo was confident that he could defeat them with his 1,000 guards, even if there was a high-level golden boss among them, Wang Shuo was not afraid at all.

Wang Shuo's three-headed hellhound troops were all supplemented from the golden fire cavalry. As early as a few days ago, the number of people had been expanded to 1,000. Each person's level was as high as level 35. With the three-headed dogs under their crotch, the combat power was extremely terrifying.

Each three-headed dog can release three skills.

Two attack skills and one recovery skill. If 1,000 flames were activated, it would be terrifying to think about it, if they could hit the boss at the same time.

At this moment, a system prompt startled Wang Shuo.

[Scarborough Market was breached by the Undead Legion. ]

The reason why Wang Shuo was surprised was that this town was known as the strongest town in Changping County.

And the mayor Lawrence had also attended the auction with Wang Shuo.

At the same time, Wang Shuo also noticed that more than half of the villages in Nanshan had been destroyed.

More than 30 messages were sent to Wang Shuo asking for help.

Some people did not ask for help, either because they did not need to ask for help or because they did not need to be rescued.

Wang Shuo closed the message and looked at the altar in front of him.

There were still hundreds of burning legions covered in flames around.

"Charge."

Wang Shuo shouted, and countless hellhounds ran hard.

Both came from hell, and when they met on a narrow road, the brave one won!

Wang Shuo held the Bloodthirsty Gun, and the hellhound formed by the combination of Dahuang, Erhei and Xiaohu under his seat was mighty and domineering, and rushed towards the undead warriors in the direction of the altar without fear.

Hazamu didn't expect that the humans in the opposite wall would dare to go out of the city to fight.

He also snorted coldly, and just when he was worried about not finding a way to vent, he galloped on his horse and rushed towards Wang Shuo's army with his men.

The war was about to break out.

After nearly a month of practice, Wang Shuo's "Black Dragon Sutra" was successfully cultivated to the second level. After the job transfer to the intermediate general, his combat power soared straight, and with the three-headed dog under his seat, he was full of confidence.

"Dang."

The collision between the spear and the flaming sword, the huge recoil force, made Wang Shuo clearly feel the gap between himself and the golden boss.

Although Wang Shuo was not injured in this attack, if Da Huang hadn't adjusted his body shape at the moment of passing by, Wang Shuo might have been knocked to the ground.

In the collision between the main generals, Wang Shuo was at a disadvantage.

But in the confrontation between the entire legion, the three-headed dog legion, relying on the advantage of numbers, killed dozens of skeleton soldiers with residual blood.

This shocked Wang Shuo.
